overview_description.description:
Dramatize aims to become the Netflix for Indian content, while not just targeting India, but also International markets like USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Africa & Middle East, where there's already a huge unmet demand for Indian content.

On Dramatize, besides watching their favorite TV shows online, fans can also watch the shows in multiple-foreign language subtitles, essentially breaking down all language barriers for accessing Indian TV content. 

At present, India has no Netflix, Hulu or IMDB type of service available, and so Dramatize began with a mission to bring prime-time Indian television content to the web, making it accessible to Indians across the globe as well as introducing it to an International audience using the power of crowd-sourced subtitles, which is great for TV networks too, since they will not only obtain new and unique revenue opportunities, but also unlock new markets that were previously completely untapped by these networks.
